name: nivqra-authority-review
description: Prepare inactive agent mandates, permission matrices and scenario specifications from stated operating boundaries.

interface.shortDescription: Draft agent mandates and scenario review packs.
interface.longDescription: Turn a stated agent workflow into an inactive machine-mandate draft, a permission matrix, a review report and acceptance-test specifications. Preserve missing information and flag conflicting limits. This authoring workflow does not connect to a live NIVQRA workspace, grant authority or execute actions.
defaultPrompt: Draft a mandate for a research agent with EUR spending limits.
Review my agent authority draft for missing boundaries.
Prepare human-approval and refusal test cases for this mandate.
